Class CurrentRepoGateway

java.lang.Object
guiLessonSupport.CurrentRepoGateway
All Implemented Interfaces:
LessonGateway
public final class CurrentRepoGateway extends Object implements LessonGateway
Uses the current repository's Database methods, not the incompatible older ZIP API. The acting contributor is obtained from the stable authenticated session on every call, never from widgets or Database's mutable account-details cache. The default constructor connects persistent TP2 locks and experiences through PersistentAdditionalAccess. @author Kanish Garg
